caveats: ⚑ skill2 has NO activation clause in the kit text — the interval:10s trigger is an INVENTED cadence, not kit-stated. Both skill2 blocks share it; if the real trigger is a full-charge/hit-count event the uptime of the 5s ATK window changes materially.

⚑ skill1's 'landing a Full Charge attack' / 'landing an attack on a target's core' triggers are proxied by shotFired (+ requiresCore for the core branch). On a charge SR every trigger pull is intended as a full charge, but shotFired does not verify charge level, and requiresCore is a boolean fight-level gate rather than a per-shot core roll — so the Pierce Damage buff is credited at 100% uptime wherever core exposure exists.
⚑ Base cadence (chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141 / ammo 6) is datamined and unverified; shot count per fight — and therefore the refresh cadence of every shotFired-keyed block — rides on it.

skill2's ally block is authored as targets {kind:'allies'} with no excludeSelf, so the caster receives BOTH the self atkPct 30.78% and the casterAtkPct 30.78% grant. That is the literal NIKKE reading of 'Affects all allies', but it is a stacking assumption worth confirming against a fight.

Burst damage carries no explicit noFb and no explicit crit: FB exemption is left to burst-cast timing (a burst cast resolves before the Full Burst window opens), and crit eligibility is left to the engine's rider-crit path. Neither is measured for this unit.
pierceDamagePct is only live for Pierce-tagged hits; mari's own hits are Pierce-tagged solely inside skill2's 5s gainPierce windows (no whole-fight hasPierce flag is set).
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Mari (SR/Electric/Supporter/Burst II) is modeled as a pure support: skill1 grants the team Pierce Damage ▲40.99%/10s on core-landing shots (shotFired + requiresCore, allies); skill2 self-grants Pierce for 5s plus ATK ▲30.78%/5s and grants all allies a flat ATK add of 30.78% of mari's own ATK for 5s, both on an ⚑ invented interval trigger because the kit text gives skill2 no activation clause; her burst deals 639.36% of final ATK as burst-cast damage to the enemy and grants all allies Attack Damage ▲40.99% for 10s.
